name: gumushaneden
description: Tell it your budget and who the gift is for, and it puts together a set of regional foods from Gümüşhane, Türkiye — pestil, köme and more — with the reason for every item. Prices and stock come from the store in real time, and products that are out of stock are never suggested. You complete the purchase on gumushaneden.com. Ships worldwide.

interface.longDescription: Tell it your budget and who the gift is for, and it puts together a set of regional foods from Gümüşhane, Türkiye — pestil, köme and more — with the reason for every item. Prices and stock come from the store in real time, and products that are out of stock are never suggested. You complete the purchase on gumushaneden.com. Ships worldwide.
defaultPrompt: Anneme 1000 lira bütçeyle bir hediye seti hazırla, ceviz sevmiyor
Bol Cevizli Köme hakkında detay ver

positive.description: Build a gift set within a stated budget while honouring a dietary preference
positive.prompt: Build a gift box of regional Turkish foods for my mother with a 1000 lira budget — she does not like walnuts
positive.expected_behavior: A gift-set card (4 items by default; ChatGPT may request 2-8) totalling at most 1000 TRY, each with the reason it was chosen. No walnut items. Only in-stock, shippable products. Shows the budget bar, shipping status and next gift threshold. Ends with a button opening the cart on gumushaneden.com.

positive.description: Browse the catalogue for a product family and see live prices and stock
positive.prompt: Show me the köme varieties you have in stock
positive.expected_behavior: A product card grid: real photo, the price actually paid, the struck-through list price when discounted, an honest stock badge and a link to the product page. Sold-out or storefront-hidden products are never returned. An unverified price is left empty, never guessed.

positive.description: Inspect one product before buying: variants, weight, stock
positive.prompt: Tell me more about Bol Cevizli Köme
positive.expected_behavior: A detail card for that product: photo, current price with struck-through list price, stock badge, every purchasable variant with its own price and weight, and a button opening the product page on gumushaneden.com. Fields the store does not provide are omitted, never invented.

positive.description: Turn the suggested items into a real cart and hand off to the store checkout
positive.prompt: Add one 500 g Bol Cevizli Köme to my cart and give me the purchase link
positive.expected_behavior: A real cart is created on gumushaneden.com and the reply returns its checkout URL (/checkout?id=<cart-id>&step=info) holding exactly that item at the same price. No payment, card or address data is handled in ChatGPT. It may look the product up first.

positive.description: Ask about delivery time, shipping cost and current campaigns
positive.prompt: How long does delivery to Istanbul take, and when is shipping free?
positive.expected_behavior: Delivery estimate of 1-3 business days, as an estimate; free shipping at any total for pestil/köme, mixed, gift and Kendin Seç packs, otherwise from 2000 TRY (below that the fee is shown at checkout); cash-on-delivery surcharge; 16:00/13:00 cut-offs; gift thresholds. Never asks for an address.

negative.description: Tracking an existing shipment. The app has no order or tracking tool and no account concept, but the name of its shipping tool can look relevant.
negative.prompt: Where is my package? My tracking number is 1234567890

negative.description: Travel and tourism advice about the city of Gümüşhane. The app is named after the region, which makes it look relevant, but it only sells food products.
negative.prompt: How do I get to Gümüşhane and where should I stay for two nights?

negative.description: Asking how to make a regional food at home. The app knows these products but sells them; it has no recipe tool and should not be invoked for cooking instructions.
negative.prompt: How do I make pestil at home? Give me the recipe

review.commerce_description: Recommends products from gumushaneden.com and can create a cart on the store. Checkout and payment always happen on gumushaneden.com; no payment, card or address data is collected inside ChatGPT, and no order is placed by the app.

publication.release_notes:
- Shipping, delivery time and cash-on-delivery questions are answered from the store's live shipping terms, never from memory
- Delivery estimates are consistent everywhere: by province when you name one, otherwise for Türkiye overall
- "Dut pestili" now finds Sade Pestil, the store's plain mulberry pestil
- If a product is not sold under the name you used, the app tells you which product it picked and asks before adding it to the cart

tr-TR.subtitle: Yöresel gıda hediye seti
tr-TR.description: Bütçenizi ve kime alacağınızı söyleyin; Gümüşhane'nin yöresel gıdalarından — pestil, köme ve daha fazlası — her kalemin neden seçildiği yazılı bir hediye seti hazırlasın. Fiyat ve stok mağazadan anlık gelir, tükenen ürün önerilmez. Satın almayı gumushaneden.com'da tamamlarsınız. Tüm dünyaya gönderim yapılır.
